title: Europeans 'will be legitimate targets' if they join war, Iran's deputy FM warns
summary: In an interview with FRANCE 24, Iran's Deputy Foreign Minister Majid Takht-Ravanchi said Tehran had "already informed the Europeans and everybody else that they should be careful not to be involved in this war of aggression against Iran".
